Oracle Layoffs for September Already Started? Check Details

Oracle faces growing employee anxiety over potential layoffs, with reports suggesting 7,000 to 10,000 jobs could be affected globally. The uncertainty comes as the company cuts costs and invests heavily in AI infrastructure, even while its stock valuation rises sharply on strong investor confidence.
